title: Preparedness Services Entitlements — Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
Pre-loss facility surveys (shutoff mapping and emergency profile) and on-site staff emergency-response training sessions included in, or charged under, each tier of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. Fees are in US dollars.

| Tier | Facility surveys included per term | Fee per survey beyond those included | Training sessions included per term | Fee per training session beyond those included | Attendees per training session |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 1 | 185.00 | 0 | 425.00 | 0 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 2 | 165.00 | 0 | 395.00 | 12 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 5 | 145.00 | 1 | 345.00 | 15 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 10 | 125.00 | 2 | 295.00 | 20 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 25 | 95.00 | 6 | 245.00 | 25 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |

## Entitlement notes

- **Facility surveys included**: pre-loss facility surveys (shutoff mapping, emergency profile) included per term, as a count.
- **Survey fee**: the fee per facility survey beyond those included.
- **Training sessions included**: on-site staff emergency-response training sessions included per term, as a count.
- **Training session fee**: the fee per training session beyond those included.
- **Attendees per training session**: the number of attendees per training session.

## Reading across tiers

- The Ready Profile and Silver Priority Service Agreements include no training session; every training session at those tiers is beyond the included count.
- The Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement includes no surveys and no training sessions and shows no fee for either.
- Survey and training fees step down as the tier rises, from 185.00 and 425.00 at Ready Profile to 95.00 and 245.00 at Portfolio Master.
